setup_dataset_and_loader: create a SegmentContextData dataset and DataLoader from training options for voxel model training
get_scores_from_datapoint: run forward pass through context_net and seg_net to compute scores from a batch of datapoints
get_train_parser: build an argparse parser with training, model, dataset, and directional placement flags for geoscorer training
load_context_segment_checkpoint: load a saved model checkpoint with context_net, seg_net, and optimizer state dicts from disk
save_checkpoint: save model state dicts, optimizer state, metadata, and training options to a checkpoint file on disk
